headline: Nova Southeastern loses its unbeaten record to Montevallo
dek: The conference's last unbeaten program finally fell to Montevallo, leaving Nova Southeastern with eleven wins, seven draws, and one loss. That defeat leaves every team in the SSC with at least one loss, even though both Nova Southeastern and Eckerd went through conference play unbeaten.
displaced_by: Nova Southeastern lost to Montevallo, ending the conference's last unbeaten season

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Scoring and standing agree: the sides at the head of the table, Eckerd, Nova Southeastern, and Florida Tech, are its highest scorers, and every other program has scored fewer than Eckerd's 36.

wire.line: Every program in the conference now has a defeat after Montevallo beat Nova Southeastern.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Florida Tech has won fourteen matches, more than any other program in the conference.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Genesis Hernandez has scored seventeen goals and added five assists for Nova Southeastern, from 99 shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Madi Winn has kept ten shutouts in goal for Eckerd.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Six matches have passed their date with no result published, and Florida Tech's home match against Tampa is among them.

last_match.line: Montevallo had already held Florida Tech to a draw before ending Nova Southeastern's unbeaten season.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
